fields.description: The Source Terraces is the final release in Aldar’s Source collection at Saadiyat Grove. The stepped building combines one to four-bedroom apartments with shared wellness, fitness and social spaces in Abu Dhabi’s Cultural District.

overview: Bjarke Ingels Group designed the terraced building. The published interior palettes are Light Feather and Dusk Harmony. Ask which palette and terrace configuration belong to a particular unit before comparing its specification.
Shared facilities include quiet spaces for reading and working alongside pools, exercise rooms and a cinema. Access terms and operating charges need confirmation when selecting a home.
research.locationNote: At Saadiyat Grove on Saadiyat Island, within the Cultural District. Museum and sea views are unit-dependent; the neighbourhood description does not establish a guaranteed outlook.
research.priceNote: The fact sheet and portal show AED 3m at launch. Property Finder separately shows resale asking prices and no developer stock. Confirm current availability and terms.
research.paymentNote: The published plan is 10% booking, 50% during construction and 40% at handover. Instalment dates and any revised offer must be checked against the chosen unit’s contract.
research.handoverNote: The fact sheet gives Q3 2027, consistent with the portal’s August 2027 estimate. A dated developer completion notice has not been verified.
